newsitem.title: USA: Ameriwood sees Q1 gain from litigation.
newsitem.headline: Ameriwood sees Q1 gain from litigation.

text.p: Ameriwood Industries International Corp said Monday it expects a one-time, after-tax gain of $4.5-$4.9 million, or $1.05-$1.15 a share, in the first quarter as a result of a litigation settlement.
Ameriwood said it reached a settlement related to long-standing litigation against its former auditors. The litigation related to services provided to the company from 1986-1990, it said.
Under terms of the settlement, reached in U.S. District Court for the Western District of Michigan in Grand Rapids, Mich., Ameriwood will receive $6.25 million before expenses.
A related counterclaim against Ameriwood was dropped, the company said.

"The favorable outcome puts to rest the last of several longstanding legal and enviromental issues that have affected the company during the past few years," Neil Diver, chairman, said in a statement. "The removal of these distractions enables management to move forward in its effort to revitalize Ameriwood and maximize value for shareholders."
Ameriwood sells unassembled furniture for the home and office, as well as stereo speakers.
